tiers.SILVER_TRAINING_ELIGIBLE: SILVER product allowed to supervise INTERNAL research training runs, but only for spatially disjoint training units and only while every gate G1-G8 below is satisfied for the specific paired EO product. SILVER labels are occupancy summaries, never ground truth.
tiers.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ONLY: Product usable for comparison, calibration, visual review and external-reference metrics, never as a training target. Within any one experiment the same SILVER product on an evaluation unit is automatically EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ONLY there even when it is SILVER_TRAINING_ELIGIBLE elsewhere.
tiers.FINAL_GOLD_EVAL_ONLY: GOLD label (field/UAV/expert-verified, tier per AGENTS.md data provenance policy) reserved for final evaluation. NO GOLD LABELS EXIST IN THE PILOT (GOLD count = 0).

eligibility_gates_carried_forward: G1_PROVENANCE: every training example carries dataset manifest entry, source product id, adapter version, support resolution, and per-pixel UNKNOWN mask; unprovenanced pixels are dropped
G2_GOLD_ISOLATION: no GOLD site, scene or adjacent (buffered) unit may occur in training; verified with spartina.evaluation.splits.assert_spatially_disjoint
G3_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_EVALUATION: metrics are reported per source family and year; SILVER agreement is never called accuracy and no pooled ground-truth accuracy is reported
G4_SPATIAL_LEAKAGE_CONTROL: only spatially disjoint W10-cell splits with buffers; a split manifest plus leakage report are required before any training
G5_LICENSE: internal research only under the explicit per-family license classes below; no commercial use; source archives and label-derived bytes are never redistributed

G6_UNKNOWN_SEMANTICS: CMSA gridcode-0 regions are an ignore mask; GEODATA in-window background is a WEAK negative under a documented class-balancing scheme; out-of-window/uncovered pixels are ignored, not negative
G7_PILOT_ISOLATION: recommendation that the 20 Issue #19 pilot cells be excluded from any training set feeding the Issue #20 benchmark; owner decides at Issue #20 setup

new_gate.rule: a SILVER label support (cell x family-year) is training-eligible with a paired EO product ONLY when that exact EO product passes the actual observed-mask gate INSIDE the W10 Albers cell (pixel-centre rule): actual_observed_fraction_in_w10_cell >= 0.95, with S2 requiring all required SR bands finite and S1 requiring the local s1_dualpol_valid_v2 token (finite VV AND finite VH AND both > -70 dB). Eligibility is evaluated per (support, EO product) pair; a multimodal stack does not transfer eligibility between sensors. A support with no same-year pilot EO product is UNMEASURED by this pilot, never silently eligible. Gate WARN evidence (edge-resampling delta, grid-vs-cell fraction near the threshold) is recorded on the pair but does not retract eligibility when the in-cell fraction passes; any hard gate FAIL makes the pair ineligible.
